source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_authoring_ingress.py tests/test_task.py tests/test_review.py tests/test_review_transport.py tests/test_publication.py -q
python -m pytest tests/test_operator.py -k "ingress or review or remediation or repair or publication" -q

claims.claim: Implemented formal carrier-neutral authoring ingress contract (IngressEnvelope, read_carrier_input, parse_envelope) supporting AUTHOR_TASK, SUBMIT_REVIEW, AUTHOR_REMEDIATION, and AUTHOR_REPAIR with versioning, operation identity, and explicit expected state validation.

Implemented AUTHOR_TASK ingress supporting new TASK revision 1, consecutive revision continuity N+1, expected main SHA verification, and canonicalization at .ai/tasks/<task_id>.yaml on main with idempotent identical payload replay.

Implemented SUBMIT_REVIEW ingress validating canonical candidate ref, artifacts, and REVIEW contract, binding reviewed_sha to candidate SHA, and isolating review decisions to refs/heads/aios/review-decision/<run_id> to maintain implementation main purity.
Implemented SUBMIT_REVIEW with CHANGES_REQUIRED making review findings observable immediately through unified state reduction (observe_unified_state) without RUN creation or Executor invocation.
Implemented SUBMIT_REVIEW with PASS preserving publication boundary without premature main publication, enabling independent publication through publish_review_decision.

Implemented AUTHOR_REMEDIATION and AUTHOR_REPAIR ingress operations targeting isolated refs refs/heads/aios/remediation/<source_run_id>-<finding_id> and refs/heads/aios/repair/<failed_run_id> with expected state verification and scope enforcement.
Implemented deterministic CAS concurrency protection with expected SHA assertions, stale predecessor detection, conflicting attempt rejection, and identical replay idempotency.
Implemented strict authority separation and deterministic canonical destination derivation, rejecting client-provided destination paths, git commands, and authority overrides.
Implemented CLI operator command 'ingress' (with alias 'ingest') and Python entry points read_carrier_input, parse_envelope, and execute_ingress supporting file and stdin carrier inputs.
Implemented comprehensive deterministic test suite covering envelope validation, carrier parsing, all four authoring operations, CAS protections, and authority separation.
